# Let's import Aeolus

```{r}
library(tidytext)
library(tidyverse)

aeolus <- tibble(
  line = readLines("text/2_Odyssey/7_Aeolus/7_Aeolus.txt")
)

group_sections <- function(section_divider_col) {
  # Initialise empty column for group IDs.
  # When you read "Advanced R" sometime, you'll learn this
  # is good practice when using an R for-loop
  groups <- rep(0, length(section_divider_col))

  # We are going to "loop" over the columns of TRUEs and FALSEs.
  # Each time we encounter a T, we will add 1 to the group ID.
  current_group_id <- 0

  # Here is a for-loop. You will learn about them in Chapter 21
  # of 'R for Data Science'. You rarely need to write these in
  # text analyses. In fact, it's been so long since I had to write
  # one, I had to look it up again...
  for (idx in seq_along(section_divider_col)) {
    boolean_value <- section_divider_col[[idx]]
    if (isTRUE(boolean_value)) {
      current_group_id <- current_group_id + 1
    }
    groups[idx] <- current_group_id
  }
  return(groups)
}


```

# Find line numbers of each headline

```{r}
aeolus <- aeolus %>% 
  mutate(is_capitals = str_detect(line, "^[^a-z]+$")) %>% 
  mutate(previous_is_true = lag(is_capitals, n = 1, default = FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(split_on = is_capitals & !previous_is_true) %>% 
  mutate(section = group_sections(split_on))
```

```{r}

tidy_aeolus <- unnest_tokens(aeolus, word, line)

# afinn scores the words from -5 to 5
get_sentiments("afinn")

# bing designates a word as positive or negative
get_sentiments("bing")

# nrc adds degrees of affect  
get_sentiments("nrc")

# syuzhet scores the words as a decimal between -1 and 1
get_sentiment_dictionary()

```
```{r}

install.packages("syuzhet")
library(syuzhet)

```

```{r}
syuzhet_aeolus <- tidy_aeolus %>%
  left_join(get_sentiment_dictionary(), by = "word")
```

# View() allows you to view the tibble 

```{r}
View(tidy_aeolus)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = syuzhet_aeolus,
       mapping = aes(x = as.factor(section), weight = value)) +
  geom_bar() + 
  labs(x = "Microtext", y = "Total Sentiment Score")
```
```{r}
ggsave("aeolus-sentiment-plots/syuzhet_aeolus_plot.png", width = 14, height = 10)
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = syuzhet_aeolus,
       mapping = aes(x = as.factor(section), weight = abs(value))) +
  geom_bar() + 
  labs(x = "Microtext", y = "Total Sentiment Score")
```

```{r}
ggsave("aeolus-sentiment-plots/syuzhet_aeolus_abs_plot.png", width = 14, height = 10)
```
